name: my-mc-v2
description: A Minecraft-like 3D voxel sandbox game built with Three.js and TypeScript.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tests-node.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json --noEmit
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
scripts.check:full: pnpm run check && pnpm run test:e2e:run
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=my-mc-v2 --branch=main
scripts.deploy:preview: pnpm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=my-mc-v2 --branch=preview
